ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >85% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) linear disruptions providing a localized contrast ratio of approximately 4:1 in scarred regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base. High-intensity linear streaks distributed stochastically across both lobes. A localized high-intensity pixel cluster is visible at the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (3-5 pixels) and deeper irregular notches (15-20 pixels) along the mid-section of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, raised-texture pixel groupings concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of intersecting, high-intensity linear segments (rake marks) covering approximately 30% of the visible surface, primarily oriented in diagonal vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across the ventral surface in the form of intersecting linear rake marks; significant barnacle colonization present at the fluke tips.
